html:
Ninh Van Bay Nha Trang is one of the most captivating coastal destinations in central Vietnam, renowned for its untouched beauty, crystal-clear waters, and peaceful atmosphere. This one-day Ninh Van Bay travel guide for 2026 offers a comprehensive overview of how to get there, what to do, what to eat, and essential tips to help you enjoy a smooth and memorable journey.

Perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, nature, and unique marine experiences, Ninh Van Bay is an ideal escape from the bustling city life of Nha Trang.

Where Is Ninh Van Bay And What Makes It Special?

Ninh Van Bay is located on Hon Meo Peninsula, in Ninh Hoa District, Khanh Hoa Province, approximately 60 kilometers north of Nha Trang city. Unlike many other beaches in Nha Trang, Ninh Van Bay remains largely untouched by urban development, preserving its pristine coastline, soft white sand, vibrant coral reefs, and rich marine ecosystem.

What truly sets Ninh Van Bay apart is its serene and secluded atmosphere. Surrounded by mountains and the open sea, the bay offers a rare sense of privacy and harmony with nature. In the early morning, the bay is often covered in a gentle mist, creating a dreamlike and romantic landscape that leaves a lasting impression on visitors.

Often referred to as the “Maldives of Vietnam,” Ninh Van Bay is also home to exclusive eco-luxury resorts designed to blend seamlessly with the natural environment. Built using sustainable materials such as wood and bamboo, these resorts provide an ideal retreat for honeymooners, couples, and families seeking relaxation and comfort in a natural setting.

How To Get To Ninh Van Bay Nha Trang

There are two main ways to reach Ninh Van Bay: by speedboat or by road.

Traveling By Speedboat – Fast And Scenic

Taking a speedboat is the most convenient and time-saving option. From Nha Trang Port (Cau Da Port), the journey takes approximately 20–30 minutes. Ticket prices range from 150,000 to 250,000 VND per person per trip, depending on the boat and season.

Many travelers prefer booking a Nha Trang day tour package, which includes round-trip speedboat transfers, activities, and meals. It is highly recommended to book in advance, especially during peak travel seasons, to avoid long waiting times.

Traveling By Motorbike Or Car – A Flexible Adventure

For those who enjoy scenic road trips, traveling by motorbike or car is an excellent option. From Nha Trang city center, follow Tran Phu Bridge, continue along Pham Van Dong Street, and then head north on National Highway 1A. After approximately 36 kilometers, turn right at Ninh Da and continue toward Hyundai Port to reach Ninh Van Bay.

The coastal route offers breathtaking views of the sea and mountains, making it ideal for photography and short stops along the way. Motorbike rental costs around 100,000–150,000 VND per day, while car rental prices vary depending on vehicle type.

What To Do On A One-Day Ninh Van Bay Tour

A day at Ninh Van Bay promises unforgettable experiences, from underwater exploration to relaxing seaside activities.

Snorkeling And Diving To Explore Coral Reefs

Ninh Van Bay boasts a rich marine ecosystem with colorful coral reefs and diverse sea life. Snorkeling and scuba diving are must-try activities here. Visitors are provided with full equipment and guided by experienced instructors.

Beneath the clear waters, you will encounter vibrant corals, tropical fish, starfish, and other fascinating marine creatures. Snorkeling is suitable for beginners, while scuba diving offers a deeper exploration. Prices typically range from 300,000 to 500,000 VND, depending on the service.

Surfing And Paddleboarding For Adventure Lovers

For thrill-seekers, surfing and paddleboarding offer exciting ways to enjoy the sea. With gentle to moderate waves, Ninh Van Bay is suitable for both beginners and experienced surfers. Equipment rental and professional instruction are available, with prices starting from 200,000–400,000 VND per hour.

Fishing And Relaxing At Sea

If you prefer a slower pace, fishing on a boat in the calm waters of the bay is a peaceful and rewarding experience. Enjoy the fresh sea breeze while waiting for your catch. Many tours offer fishing combined with a freshly prepared seafood lunch on board.

Discover Hidden Beaches And Coastal Caves

Beyond the main beach, Ninh Van Bay features secluded beaches and small caves waiting to be explored. Kayaking or hiring a small boat allows you to reach these hidden spots, offering privacy and unique photo opportunities amid dramatic rock formations and lush greenery.

What To Eat On A One Day Ninh Van Bay Tour

Ninh Van Bay offers a delightful culinary experience, combining fresh seafood with traditional Nha Trang flavors.

  • Jellyfish Noodle Soup (Bun Sua): A signature dish of Nha Trang, featuring fresh jellyfish, fish cake, fish roe, and a light, flavorful broth.

  • Fish Cake Thick Noodle Soup (Banh Canh Cha Ca): A comforting dish made with chewy noodles and naturally sweet fish cake.

  • Fresh Seafood: Lobster, crab, squid, clams, and fish are freshly caught and prepared to order—grilled, steamed, or stir-fried.

  • Anchovy Salad (Goi Ca Mai): A refreshing local specialty made with fresh anchovies, herbs, peanuts, and a tangy dipping sauce.

  • Nha Trang Grilled Fermented Pork Rolls (Nem Nuong): Served with rice paper, herbs, and signature dipping sauce, this iconic dish is a must-try.

Important Tips For A One Day Ninh Van Bay Trip

  • Best Time To Visit: March to September offers sunny weather and calm seas.

  • Book In Advance: Reserve speedboat transfers and water activities during peak seasons.

  • Pack Essentials: Sunscreen, swimwear, sunglasses, hats, and a camera are essential.

  • Protect The Environment: Do not litter, avoid touching corals, and respect marine life.

Final Thoughts

Ninh Van Bay Nha Trang is a true coastal paradise, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, adventure, relaxation, and culinary delights. Whether you are snorkeling among coral reefs, enjoying fresh seafood, or simply unwinding on a secluded beach, a one-day Ninh Van Bay tour will undoubtedly be a highlight of your Nha Trang journey.
